recorded_stage: D, before L0 counts and before computed outcome proportions
L0_income_counts: Report each of 10 official imputations separately; use minimum draw count within each period against the unchanged >=1000 gate. Also report observed-income-only counts. Never sum imputed rows as people.
main_weight: WTFA_A/2.75 for pre-period records; WTFA_A/2 for main post-period records. The 2022 Q1-Q3 contributes 0.75 year; transition Q4 excluded.
standard_population: Literal contract: all full years 2019-2024 H age>=50, valid sex; annual WTFA_A/6. This includes 2020 and transition Q4 as reference-composition observations only. Reference distribution treated as fixed for standardization.
standardization: Age4 by sex8 cells. Additive survey LPM y~post+age_sex; weighted marginal prediction in fixed reference. For this additive LPM, standardized difference equals post coefficient.
variance: Use original public PSTRAT and PPSU across years as official examples prescribe; no year prefix; full survey design before domain subset. With-replacement Taylor linearization. 95% t interval with survey model residual df.
annual_event_rates: Saturated year by age_sex survey LPM; marginal prediction using same fixed pooled H reference; 2022 uses Q1-Q3. 2020 displayed only. 2025 separate extension.
H_missingness: H=1 if aid yes OR difficulty2/3/4; H=0 only if aid no and difficulty1; otherwise H unknown. Main outcome missing if HEARAID not1/2, even where H known.
secondary_income_model: y~post*income_group+age_sex within H and low/high groups; low<2 versus high>=4; ten official income draws; Rubin pooled coefficient and variance. Low-minus-high difference in changes positive denotes narrowing in uptake disadvantage.
age_gradient_model: H; y~post*age_band+sex, comparing50-69 to80plus. No difficulty-severity treatment/control groups.
pretrend_sensitivity: Survey LPM y~year_centered+age_sex restricted to pre observations. Extrapolate to weighted post calendar-year mean; report observed-standardized-post minus extrapolated trend with joint design linearized covariance.
frequency: All-time HEARAIDFR_A=1 among HEARAID_A=1 with valid frequency1-4; age-sex adjusted pre/post difference.
mode_sensitivity: Add factor(INTMODESA) all/some/none telephone to main model on valid-mode respondents; report availability and paired complete-mode baseline.
insurance: MA determined from documented COVER65_A hierarchy for MA; traditional Medicare combines Medicare recipients without MA using official MA responses/recode; report exact operational coding and unknowns. VA/TRICARE uses corrected MILSPC1R_A or MILSPC2_A positive. Descriptive only.
